notes:
### Added

- Date and time in the menu bar: choose an icon, date and time, or both, with localized presets and a custom format editor.

### Improved

- Meeting indicators adapt to your layout: meeting status stays alongside DayEdge in icon-only mode and appears separately when date and time are shown.
- Smoother navigation: switching views crossfades the content while controls stay in place, and moving between days uses subtle directional transitions.

### Fixed

- Popover placement near screen edges: the panel stays within the display while its arrow follows the DayEdge icon.
- Correct date badges: day numbers display in full; event counts still use 9+.
- Reliable panel toggling: clicking the menu-bar icon while the panel is open closes it without blinking.

First public release of DayEdge, a native calendar and reminders app for your Mac menu bar.

- Month and daily agendas with events, reminders, and weather.
- Natural-language event and task entry, unified search, and optional calendar chat.
- Meeting alerts with compact and full-screen reminders.
- Eight themes and English and Polish interfaces.

Requires macOS 15 or later. Optional on-device chat requires macOS 26 and Apple Intelligence; external providers are opt-in.

### Install with Homebrew

```sh
brew install --cask dayedge/tap/dayedge
```

Homebrew selects the Apple Silicon or Intel archive and verifies its SHA-256 checksum.

This release is self-signed and not notarized by Apple. The [Homebrew cask](https://github.com/dayedge/homebrew-tap) removes download quarantine from DayEdge.app after installation and upgrades. Global macOS security settings are unchanged.

For manual installation, use `arm64` on Apple Silicon or `x86_64` on Intel. See the [installation instructions](https://github.com/dayedge/dayedge#install) for first-launch guidance.
